reviews.text:
I am absolutely over the moon with how my ragdoll cat Baloo was looked after when we went on holiday for 2 weeks. Lovely little cattery and spacious.
I thought I was due home on the Tuesday but realised it was the Wednesday and they phoned me while I was away on the Tuesday as that was the day I was supposed to pick Baloo up and without any hesitation booked him in for an extra night at short notice.

I will definitely be using them again 😃

As ever Cleo was very well looked after and Meryam said she was a good sweet girl. Always happy to board her here as a first class service is always provided and we're happy in the knowledge that she is safe and content. Thank you 😊 …

We have been using Village Garden Cattery for a number of year's and we are always reassured that our cats will be looked after. They have a wonderful environment and the staff clearly care for our pets like they are their own. Will always recommend! Thank you
Cats looked after very well cats happy there attentive dancer and Elsa

Took our elderly cat (nearly 17 years old) for a 10 day holiday. The pen is spacious enough for upstairs living with downstairs toileting and room to roam.
This is our third time of using Village Garden Cattery and the staff are always welcoming.  This time we needed to make them aware of medication and dietary requirements which I needn’t of worried about. They asked that we take the medication along with our own special food as it wasn’t one they stocked which I thought was fair enough- they can’t be expected to stock everything!
When we went to collect, the lady walked up to his pen and his tail went up immediately which to us showed he had enjoyed his time away.
I would definitely recommend and we will be back again in the near future.
Thanks again to all the staff for your care and love.
Lee was incredibly accommodating for a last minute request and the cats always return happy and relaxed. Very friendly professional service.

My cat has stayed at Donna and Lee's cattery a good few times now. My cat is timid and I would only ever leave her at this cattery as Donna and Lee are passionate about cats and making their stay comfortable.  The accommodation is very safe and the pens are very secure in a garden setting.  Would highly recommend and I wouldn't leave my cat anywhere else.  Very professional set up!
George was very well taken care of as always - thank you VG Cattery
We have used the village cattery for many years now.  I'm happy to go away knowing they are safe and well looked after.
Lovely cattery, recommended by a friend, staff are friendly and our cat is well looked after.

I booked here for our cat Milo after reading all the reviews, I have to agree with them, this cattery was very clean, in a beautiful garden.
It was Milos first time in a cattery and I was pleased I chose here, they looked after him very well, he came home happy, clean and well looked after. I messaged them to see if Milo had settled in ok, I received a reply almost immediately saying he was settling well and eating well, this put my mind at ease so I could continue to enjoy my holiday without any worries. Thank you to Donna and your team, we shall be returning.

We regularly send our cat Maple to the Cattery, she’s been several times.
We’re always greeted by pleasant, friendly staff and she is always well looked after.
Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a trusted place for their pet!

Lovely cat hotel, Fabulous staff, very attentive and sent us updates and photos. Leo was delivered back to me (a small extra cost)  and he showed no signs of stress, it was his first time boarding since I adopted him this February and ive used the Village Garden with my previous fur baby and I wouldnt go anywhere else.
Thanks to all the Vullage Garden Team.
Our cat loves coming here. We call it a cat hotel . Lovely quiet garden. Well looked after cats, owners and staff very friendly and helpful. Would highly recommend.

Picked up my 3 cats this morning. Always anxious about leaving them but as usual they've all come home looking healthy & as happy as can be! Thank you so much for taking such good care of the 3 of them. Would highly recommend you guys to anyone looking for a decent cattery. See you again next year! xx

I honestly cannot recommend Village Garden Cattery enough! From the moment we arrived, I felt completely reassured that my cat was going to be well looked after. The care, attention and love they give to the cats is absolutely amazing.
The cattery is beautifully kept, clean and peaceful, and you can tell that the welfare and happiness of the cats genuinely comes first. The staff are so friendly, caring and professional, and they kept me feeling completely at ease throughout the stay.
It can be really difficult leaving your pet somewhere, especially when they are such an important part of your family, but Village Garden Cattery gave me complete peace of mind. My cat came home happy, settled and clearly very well cared for.
Thank you so much to everyone at Village Garden Cattery for taking such wonderful care of my cat. We will definitely be using you again and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend you to anyone looking for a safe, caring and trustworthy cattery. 🐾
Absolutely fantastic service from start to finish!
Lovely cattery run by lovely people - my cat is always well looked after and seems to be treated like one of the family when he goes!
Love this place, wouldn't use anywhere else

Our cat Del is always looked after so so well at Village Garden Cattery. He always comes back happy and content. Donna and Lee run a fantastic cattery we would never ever use anywhere else. Bibi also is so friendly and looks after Del so much. Thank you all so much. Del is looking forward to his next visit.

Second year using Village Garden Cattery and we couldn’t be happier! 🐾 Winter is always so well cared for, and I’m reassured knowing her feeding instructions are followed exactly. I always get nervous leaving her, but she comes home looking well-fed, happy and very settled. Thank you for taking such great care of our girl! ❤️ …

Really pleased with this service.
We had to change Catteries as our old one closed down , and one of our cats is ex feral and very timid.
However we got a really good feel at the village and our cats seemed happy ( ish) with their stay.
The staff really seemed to know them. When we collected.

This is the 2nd year we have used VGC for my cat. It’s a lovely set up and people who clearly love cats as they have their own wandering around the garden. Each cat has a separate enclosure. My cat seems happy and looks well cared for. The receptionist at my vets also used VGC so that is also a great endorsement! Great to have a reliable and reasonably priced cattery to look after your precious pet, you can enjoy a holiday without any worry. Booking is easy and clear.
Great service, nice accommodation, reasonably priced. Could not have been more helpful when my dates changed. Would not hesitate to re-book.

My cat always has a great time here and is well looked after. Fantastic service and would highly recommend.always gives me peace of mind when go away that shes in safe hands. The owners are so helpful and have been very accommodating when ive needed to change times slightly. My cat looks forward to her next stay
Easy to book and pay for and the staff are very friendly and helpful
We have used this cattery on several occasions and have always been greeted  warmly. Our cat seems quite contented and relaxed.
Loverly people my cats were looked after and I have returned again would recommend this place my mind is at rest

We have recently used Village Garden Cattery. It is a lovely place to leave your pets. They managed to fit us in last minute as well, which was amazing. It's very close to the airport as well, which is really handy for when you're going away.
We appreciate how our is cared for. She's a n anxious and spicy girl. The staff treat her with kindness and compassion.
Caring cattery staff. My cat was very well looked after and I won't hesitate to use the cattery again. Recommended

We've been using Village Garden Cattery for a number of years now and will continue to do so.

The owners and staff are lovely and welcoming, and we always have a chat before drop off and on collection.

Our cat, Pixie, is a rescue cat, and is very shy and timid around new people. She can also get panicky if unsure of new surroundings and noise.

Village Garden Cattery are so patient with her, take time to make sure she is okay, and keep us updated when we ask. We know it takes her a few days to settle.

When we collect her, we can tell she's been treated well and has felt safe. When you have a scared and anxious cat, you can just tell if she's been okay. Pixie comes back to us looking like she has had her own holiday as well.

Thank you, and see you soon

I have been using Village Garden Cattery for 4 years and at least 3 visits every year with my cat Hugo. Staff are really helpful and friendly, booking process is easy to use but most of all my cat seems happy and relaxed when I pick him up which gives me peace of mind while I'm away on holiday. Would highly recommend the services of this cattery.
Left cats for 9 days everything good will be leaving them for a few days next month as well
Always feel reassured when my cats stayed with them. I have now used the cattery twice.

This was Smudge's first visit to Village Garden Cattery and, as he is a very nervous cat, I was also very nervous about how he would respond.  However, he returned happy and quick to settle down again at home.  The staff at the cattery couldn't have been more friendly and reassuring to me.  We will certainly be returning.  Mt thanks to all at Village Garden Cattery!
Very happy thank you very much for looking after Tym and Wyl

This is the first time we have used a cattery. Me and my wife were very anxious about leaving our cat for the very first time. From the initial phone call to meeting Bibi for the first time, we were instantly reassured by her that our cat Flossie was going to be well cared for.

Whilst on holiday, Bibi provided us with photos and messages about Flossie which made us feel more relaxed on holiday.

Will definitely be using the cattery again and would 100 % recommend them to anyone.

Thank you to Bibi and everyone who looked after and pampered our baby Flossie.
My cat was well looked after and I will use this cattery again
Max spent 8 days in village garden cattery he was well looked after and was very relaxed when I fetched him thank you Lee Donna and the staff who looked after max I would certainly use you again x
Would recommend to anyone, our little kitten was looked after extremely well and the staff were super helpful and professional.
Lovely Cattery
Drop off and pick up was easy to do, Pitch and Patch were well cared for will be using again when needed.

My 2 cats stayed here for the second time for 8 days last week. I get very nervous to leave them but the staff were so friendly and sent me an update with pictures which reassured me so much whilst i was away. Definitely will be using again in the future, thanks so much for looking after them!
We would highly recommend the Village Garden Cattery, our cats are always calm and content when we pick them up, it has a wonderful ambience and we feel reassured they are well looked after
Thank you 😁 …
Great staff always helpful and our cat is well looked after
Quick and easy pick up of my cat Sushi. Thank you. He has always been well cared for at Village Garden Cattery.

We have no reservations about leaving our two cats here. The pens are spacious with an outdoor area so they can watch what’s going on. They get lots of fusses and attention from the girls there and we never have any post stay stress after they get home.

Really amazing place, super lovely staff, checked in to let me know how the cat was doing. He was super sad to leave, will definitely use again, made everything so easy via the app and always answered any questions I had.
Village Garden Cattery is a well organised and caring cattery where the staff are friendly and clearly love cats
Thank you Barry 😁🐈 …

I will only take my cat Yoda here. They are truly fantastic and really look after the cats well. The cats have plenty of space and access to recreation unlike some other catteries. Highly recommended.
Great second home for my cats, warm welcome and great service, first time my cats have been away and they seemed settled, recommend to anyone knowing their cats are safe

We use this cattery regularly. Our cat looks well after the stay at Village Garden Cattery, is clean and well fed, doesn't smell.
I would recommend this place.

From intial contact until pick up the communication was great. I received updates on how my cat was during his stay.

The owner Lee was lovely, I made the mistake of getting caught out with the clocks going forward when I was due to drop my cat off, but he was great about being late!

The cattery itself was lovely, safe and i felt comfortable leaving my boy for the first time in his life for a week!

When we picked him up, he was happy content and we did not have anything to worry about, he was definitely well cared for! Would not hesitate to use again in the future. Thank you for looking after Lumi so well.
Amazing cattery! My cats first time at a cattery, and he came back so happy and well looked after. Staff are lovely. Great communication and very flexible x
Very friendly staff. Kept us up to date with pictures, spending time with my kitten to keep me reassured whilst making my kitten comfortable and welcome. Highly recommend.
Thank you Harry 👍 …

Left my kitten for 7 days when picked up she had poo stuck on her fur, back as well as side her face look like she hadn't slept for days when asked to send photos or videos there was no reply in future will leave with friends or family. She's Very scared now that we will leave her again .

Thank you so much to Village Garden Cattery for looking after Tigger whilst we were on holiday.

It was our first time relying on an external party and so both my husband and I were nervous but there was nothing to worry about - Tigger was looked after like he was their own.

Will definitely keep coming back, we are so happy we have found somewhere reliable and that we can trust.

A personal thankyou to Donna and Kulsoom for making sure I had updates and pictures of our little one!

We have used The Village cattery for the last 5 years. Our cat was always so well cared for whilst staying. They provide updates on how your cat is settling in and updates when you collect them. It was like leaving our cat with family. A great family run cattery.

Thank you so much for looking after our Hazel. The communication throughout was amazing. We took up the offer for Hazel to be picked up and returned to our house, and then went smoothly. We received photos and updates whilst she was away. She's come back happy and well looked after. She's a small kitten and this is the first time she's been away from home and it was an easy experience, and we wouldn't hesitate to leave her at the Village Garden Cattery.
Lovely friendly place, cats are very well looked after, we use regularly and would highly recommend
I could not recommend this cattery enough. All the staff are so lovely and helpful and they really looked after my cat! I will definitely be using their service again.
The only cattery I would take my cat to. She is well looked after and always well when I fetch her home. I would recommend Village Garden Cattery 100%. they all make you and your pet welcome.
We always leave our cat Tilly here she is always looked after very well by Donna and Lee and their lovely staff. Would highly recommend the Village Garden Cattery.
Lovely people here, very friendly and helpful.

This will be the 2nd time I've left Oreo my girl here and I wouldn't take her anywhere else you can relax on holiday knowing your cat is safe loved and looked after in their care they spend time with them fuss them and even sent me lovely photos to reassure me she was OK lovely place lovely people ❤️

Amazing cattery! Myself and my partner it was our first time using a cattery with our boy salem so we were quite nervous. Salem is a very anxious boy, however Lee and Donna were brilliant and nothing was to much trouble can't thank them enough salem has came home very happy an settled. Best cattery in Birmingham recommend to everyone 😊
Penny, our cat always come home in really good condition she is well looked after and we always feel confident leaving her with caring people who love cats

Our cat was housed at Village Garden Cattery and it was her first time ever being away from us. The staff and owners were very reassuring and made sure Luna was comfortable and well looked after while we were away. They give a lot of information beforehand on the arrangements and the to-dos which makes the process much easier for the customer. Luna came home happy and stress free. We will definitely use this service again.

Hi! Absolutely brilliant!!
In friendliness, in welcoming, at the start, at the finish... understanding about the stress of the animal (and the owner!!) An unprecedented event happened this last time with one of the cats at home before they left. So much so that the little meow arrived very poorly 😢 and didn't even hold the 💩 They took care of it and cleaned it as if it were their own.😻 Amazing team! Thank you.

What a fantastic cattery. Our cat is very special to us and finding a trusted venue for his care when we are away us important. Village Garden is just such a place. The collection service is a brilliant option and one which I would use again. Thank you Village Garden, we will be back.

I have to give a massive shoutout to everyone in this Cattery. From the moment I booked until I picked up my cat, everything was so smooth and easy. I used to leave my cat at friends places but was always worried during my time away. Now I …
My cat is staying in August

This is the second time leaving my cat George, I was nervous leaving the first time but I didn't need to be they sent me a picture of him and told me he was fine and leaving him the second time was fine. The place is clean and the people friendly and nice will leave him here again
Another lovely stay for Hagrid and Bellatrix at VGC.  Thank you all so much for looking after them so well.  See you again soon 🥰 …

Yet another amazing service from the start! Constantly updated with how Evie is getting on, receiving numerous pictures and nothing was too much trouble!
Would highly recommend, I wouldnt let Evie go anywhere else now! Thank you Donna and Lee!

This place is an absolute gem! We have only been for a viewing and really loved the place. They are very accommodating and very open and lots of room. There is always someone there, just really nice environment to be in
Thank you Ezgi x
